description: Source code for cloud provider plugin registration and initialization in Kubernetes.

methods.name: RegisterCloudProvider
methods.description: Registers a cloud provider factory by name during app startup.

methods.name: IsCloudProvider
methods.description: Checks if a cloud provider name is registered.

methods.name: GetCloudProvider
methods.description: Creates an instance of a named cloud provider, returning nil if unknown.

methods.name: IsExternal
methods.description: Determines if a provider name corresponds to an external cloud provider.

methods.name: DisableWarningForProvider
methods.description: Logs info and warnings about disabled in-tree cloud providers.

methods.name: ErrorForDisabledProvider
methods.description: Returns an error indicating that built-in cloud providers are disabled.

methods.name: InitCloudProvider
methods.description: Creates and initializes a cloud provider instance based on name and config file path.
